decisions.reason: Displayed ticket totals must exclude no-referral tickets until the separate random-referral finalization transaction has awarded them.

value_updates.expected_visible_ticket_total: Displayed ticket totals must account for one ticket per referred primary mint and for each no-referral primary mint whose separate random-referral finalization transaction has completed; secondary-market sales are excluded.

decisions.reason: The NFT attribute must show a random no-referral commission only after the separate finalization transaction has awarded it.

value_updates.random_commission_attribute_visibility: After the separate random-referral finalization transaction awards a no-referral commission, it must be displayed in NFT attributes; before finalization, there is no random commission to display.

decisions.reason: The source selects the Success-modal transaction flow and accounting timing but does not require FAQ changes; the existing no-referral allocation description remains valid at a general level.
The clarification necessarily changes when a no-referral Small Block ticket is generated and included in ticket reconciliation.

value_updates.ticket_count_reconciliation_rule: One Small Block ticket is generated for each referred primary mint and for each no-referral primary mint whose separate random-referral finalization transaction has completed; secondary-market sales generate no new ticket.
value_updates.no_referral_mint_ticket_allocation: When a primary mint has no referral code, a Small Block ticket is awarded at random to an existing NFT holder only after the separate random-referral finalization transaction completes.

decisions.reason: Random commission and ticket finalization does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source decision does not affect NFT image sizing or media rendering.
A no-referral reward finalization does not create a recorded referral or change referral-count presentation.
The separate random-referral finalization transaction does not change the next-draw countdown label or measure.
The source decision changes reward-award timing, not the counting basis for successfully completed mints.
Random allocation following a no-code mint does not constitute referral activity and therefore does not change public referral statistics.
The source decision concerns random commission and ticket finalization, not prize-pool contribution accounting.
The existing message-636 MODIFY already captures the selected manual finalization button and suppression of automatic follow-up transaction prompts; no additional change is required.
